raw_segments.text: Edgar, come on, sir, here's the place.
How fearful and dizzy tease to cast one's eyes so low.
The crows and chuffs that wing the midway air show scare so gross as beetles.
Halfway down hangs one that gathers sandfire, dreadful trade, methinks he seems no bigger
The fishermen that walk upon the beach appear like mice, and yond tall anchoring bark, diminished
to her cock, her cockabooie almost too small for sight.
The murmuring surge that on th-hunumbered idle pebble chafes cannot be heard so high.
I'll look no more, lest my brain turn, and the deficient sight topple down headlong.
